db/methods/pour-over.json.name: Pour-over
db/methods/pour-over.json.note: Bright and clean: the cup First Light was roasted for.

steps.label: Bloom
steps.detail: Wet all the grounds, then one gentle swirl.

steps.label: First pour
steps.detail: Slow circles from the centre out.

steps.label: Second pour
steps.detail: Keep the stream low and steady.

steps.label: Draw down
steps.detail: Let it drain. The bed should finish flat.

db/methods/french-press.json.name: French press
db/methods/french-press.json.note: Rounder and heavier, with the honey up front. Good for two.

steps.label: Pour
steps.detail: Fill in one go and wet everything.

steps.label: Steep
steps.detail: Lid on, plunger up. Leave it alone.

steps.label: Stir and skim
steps.detail: Break the crust, skim off the foam.

steps.label: Press
steps.detail: Press slowly, then pour right away.

db/methods/aeropress.json.name: AeroPress
db/methods/aeropress.json.note: One sweet, short mug in two minutes. Cooler water keeps it soft.

steps.label: Pour
steps.detail: Fill to the top and start the clock.

steps.label: Steep
steps.detail: Plunger in to hold it. Wait.

db/brews/cupping-1.json.note: Apricot up front, honey as it cools. This is the one for the launch.

db/brews/cupping-2.json.note: Rounder, heavier. A black tea finish, less sparkle.

reply.en: On “{{request}}”: I added an iced pour-over beside it. 20 g of coffee, 192 g of hot water brewed straight onto 128 g of ice, done in 2:30. It is today’s pick now, so the page opens on it.
reply.zh: 关于“{{request}}”：我在旁边加了一个冰手冲。20 克咖啡，192 克热水直接冲在 128 克冰上，2 分 30 秒完成。我把它设成了今日推荐，页面会默认打开它。

data.name: Iced pour-over
data.note: Brewed hot onto ice, so the apricot stays bright. Ice goes in the server first.

steps.label: Bloom
steps.detail: Wet all the grounds, then one gentle swirl.

steps.label: Draw down
steps.detail: It drips straight onto the ice.

steps.label: Swirl
steps.detail: Swirl until the ice is nearly gone, then serve over fresh ice.
